meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 处理分子生物学序列和自动分析生物信息数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理生物信息学数据，需要自动化分析流程。
copy.tagline_en: Manipulate molecular sequences and automate bioinformatics analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly work with bioinformatics data and need automated analysis pipelines.

howto.what: Claude 能够处理生物序列、文件格式转换、NCBI 数据库查询、BLAST 搜索和系统发育分析等分子生物学任务。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行 DNA/RNA/蛋白质序列分析、文件格式转换、NCBI 数据库搜索或 BLAST 比对时触发。

say.text: 帮我用FASTA格式读取序列文件，计算GC含量。
在NCBI搜索'CRISPR'相关基因，返回前5条。
对这两个序列做BLAST比对，列出前3个匹配。

howto.what_en: Claude can handle biological sequences, file format conversion, NCBI database queries, BLAST searches, and phylogenetic analysis for molecular biology tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user requests DNA/RNA/protein sequence manipulation, file format conversion, NCBI database search, or BLAST alignment.

say_en.text: Read a FASTA file and compute GC content for each sequence.
say_en.note: Claude parses FASTA and returns GC content.

say_en.text: Search NCBI for genes related to 'CRISPR' and return top 5.
say_en.note: Claude queries NCBI via Entrez and shows results.

say_en.text: BLAST these two sequences and list top 3 hits.
say_en.note: Claude runs BLAST and outputs top alignments.
